<function name="CreateNewAddonPreset" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Creates a new Preset from the given JSON string.
	</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<file line="585-L592">lua/menu/mainmenu.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="data" type="string">A JSON string containing all necessary information.
			JSON structue should be <page>Structures/Preset</page>
		</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creating a custom Preset.</description>
	<code>
local preset = {
	["enabled"] = {},
	["disabled"] = {},
	["name"] = "Example",
	["newAction"] = "" -- do nothing with addons not in the preset.
}

	</code>
